career.pci.title: JCB Cloud Migration / Batch Platform Engineering
career.pci.desc: Designed and validated cloud batch execution architecture, operational automation, and execution monitoring/log management for a project migrating an on-premises financial system to a Google Cloud-based environment.

career.cal.desc: Operated Java-based applications and built system environments for a municipal health insurance system standardization project, handling Oracle Database queries and incident root-cause analysis, application log collection/analysis, batch (job) execution verification, account and permission management, and output report debugging as part of system operations and maintenance.
career.gsifn.title: Frontend Engineer / Enterprise Web Projects

skills.opsCollab.title: Operations & Collaboration

project.hardcoreEnglish.title: Hardcore English Conversation Trainer
project.hardcoreEnglish.subtitle: AI · Personal Project
project.hardcoreEnglish.problem: Most language apps have no time pressure, so they don't build real conversational reflexes.
project.hardcoreEnglish.role: Designed the Next.js frontend and API routes, integrating Claude API for real-time chat and reports.
project.hardcoreEnglish.solution: Split the timed chat (Claude Haiku) and correction report (Claude Sonnet) across two models for speed and quality.
project.jcb.title: JCB Cloud-Native Batch Platform Migration
project.jcb.subtitle: Finance Cloud Migration
project.jcb.problem: Maintaining the legacy JP1/AJS3 batch system was creating growing operational burden and scalability constraints.
project.jcb.role: Designed the Cloud Run Jobs batch structure — wrapper shell scripts, parameter passing, and structured logging.
project.jcb.solution: Migrated JP1/AJS3 to Cloud Run Jobs with Docker, Terraform IaC, and a GitLab CI/CD pipeline.
project.jcb.results: Documented the batch structure and automation framework, laying groundwork for stable post-migration operations.
project.awsPortfolio.title: Cloud Engineer Portfolio on AWS
project.awsPortfolio.subtitle: AWS Static Hosting
project.awsPortfolio.problem: Needed a way to reliably deploy a static portfolio site and collect visitor data.
project.awsPortfolio.role: Designed the S3/CloudFront deployment structure and built the visitor counter feature with Lambda and DynamoDB.
project.awsPortfolio.solution: Set up a custom domain/HTTPS via Route 53/ACM, and automated S3 sync and CloudFront invalidation with GitHub Actions.
project.awsPortfolio.results: Automated the deployment pipeline into an operational structure that ships on every code push.
project.oracleOps.title: Oracle / Linux Operation Support
project.oracleOps.subtitle: RKKCS · National Health Insurance · Japan
project.oracleOps.problem: A health insurance system project in Japan needed fast root-cause analysis for failures and output errors.
project.oracleOps.role: Handled operations and failure analysis for a Java and Oracle SQL-based system.
project.oracleOps.solution: Managed operations via version setup, log analysis, and SQL verification, tracing account, batch, and output errors.
project.oracleOps.results: Systematized root-cause analysis and response procedures, reducing response time for recurring issues.
project.gsifnWidget.title: KOSPI IR Stock Info Widget
project.gsifnWidget.subtitle: GSIFN · Financial Frontend · Live
project.gsifnWidget.problem: Major KOSPI-listed firms needed a renewed widget for stock and financial data on their IR pages.
project.gsifnWidget.role: Owned the full lifecycle — planning, development, deployment, operations, and maintenance — of the iframe-embedded widget.
project.gsifnWidget.solution: Built the widget UI with HTML/CSS/JavaScript and ran deployment and operations on Amazon EC2 via SSH.
project.gsifnWidget.results: Ran the widget reliably across roughly 100 listed companies' IR sites, with ongoing maintenance.
